Rules.InvariantScript: "Complete all fields to register a new system user"
"The user will receive an email notification with their login credentials once registered"

Set(varRegPassword, txt_RegPassword.Text);
Set(varRegPasswordStrength, 
    If(Len(txt_RegPassword.Text) >= 12, "Strong",
        Len(txt_RegPassword.Text) >= 8, "Medium",
        Len(txt_RegPassword.Text) > 0, "Weak",
        ""));
Set(varRegFormIsValid, false)

If(varRegPasswordStrength = "", RGBA(230, 230, 230, 1),
    varRegPasswordStrength = "Weak", RGBA(189, 49, 51, 1),
    varRegPasswordStrength = "Medium", RGBA(197, 138, 22, 1),
    RGBA(45, 128, 40, 1))

If(varRegPasswordStrength = "" || varRegPasswordStrength = "Weak", RGBA(230, 230, 230, 1),
    varRegPasswordStrength = "Medium", RGBA(197, 138, 22, 1),
    RGBA(45, 128, 40, 1))
"I confirm that the user information provided is correct and the user agrees to the system terms of use"
"✓ User registered successfully. A confirmation email has been sent."
